The items required to learn elemental change depends on which element you elect to learn. reviews.detail: The archive incorrectly carries numeric Job Level 40 from the second header alongside first-header N/A requirements. Preserve both source views; whole-guide eligibility is NULL, with 40 scoped to stage 3. Converter needs Level 1 of each Endow; Elemental Change needs Level 1 of Wanted Endow. Neither activity is stated as a prerequisite for the other.

Only one 20-stone set plus one Payon Solution and one Morroc Solution is needed for the chosen Elemental Change. Converter materials are a separate one-time set requested then handed in. Unnamed entrance teachers retain separate scoped identities because this page supplies no names, coordinates or proof that they are the same actor.
